     Home  Annual Health Check Up  Annual Health Check Up        Samitivej is one of the best hospitals in Bangkok for health and wellness checkups, Samitivej offers a fully comprehensive medical examination program for both local and international patients. We strongly advocate preventive care and routine medical screenings. By catching diseases, disorders and conditions before their symptoms visibly manifest, we can save our patients time, discomfort and money.  What kinds of health check-ups are available?  We offer a wide range of specific tests and check-ups at Samitivej Hospital. In addition to the following types of examinations (listed below), we conduct screenings for gout, osteoporosis, hypertension, urinary bladder inflammation, urinary tract inflammation, infection in the lungs and many other diseases.  Physical examination  This is a preliminary health examination. Physicians provide medical advice and consultation on overall fitness, well-being and lifestyle choices.  Screenings to determine risk of developing kidney disease  These include screenings for signs of possible kidney impairment.   BUN – measures blood urea nitrogen levels  Creatinine test – measures creatinine levels   Screenings to determine risk of developing liver disease  These tests check for abnormal liver enzymes that could indicate inflammation of the liver or cirrhosis.   ALP – checks the level of alkaline phosphatase  AST – checks the level of aspartate aminotransferase  ALT – checks the level of alanine aminotransferase  Direct bilirubin – liver function test and biliary tract test  Total bilirubin – liver function test and biliary tract test  Total protein – measures protein level in the blood   Screenings to determine risk of developing cardiovascular disease  This series of tests includes screenings for risk factors that could cause clogged arteries and cardiac muscle failure.   ABI – ankle-brachial index measures blood pressure in the lower legs  EKG – electrocardiogram test measures the heart’s electrical activity  EST – exercise stress test examines the function of the heart during physical activity  HDL cholesterol – testing for good cholesterol  LDL cholesterol – testing for bad cholesterol  Total cholesterol – measures the total amount of cholesterol  Triglyceride – measures the level of triglycerides   Screenings to determine risk of developing cancer  These screenings help in the early detection of prostate cancer, breast cancer, gynecologic cancers, colon cancer and stomach cancer.   AFP – screens for elevated levels of alpha-fetoprotein, a tumor marker for the liver  CEA – screens for carcinoembryonic antigen, a tumor marker for the colon  PSA – screens for prostate-specific antigen, a tumor marker for the prostate  Pap smear – tests for cervical cancer  Digital mammogram – tests for breast cancer  Upper and lower abdominal ultrasound – screens for stomach, pancreatic and other forms of cancer   Screenings to identify thyroid dysfunction   TSH – screens for thyroid stimulating hormone  Free T3 – screens for thyroid hormone T3 in the bloodstream  Free T4 – screens for thyroid hormone T4 in the bloodstream   Preparing for a health check-up   Do not eat or drink anything at least 8 hours prior to a health check-up  Arrive at least 10 minutes prior to your appointment  Bring any previous health reports or health examination records with you  For more information or to schedule an appointment   *Required      Question*  Question*    Email Address*  Email Address*           I agree to Samitivej Hospital  Terms & Conditions and Privacy Notice    I would like to receive health news and tips from Samitivej Hospital.
